name: hk.advanpro.android.sdk.device.ota.dfu.NotificationActivity
description: When a BLE firmware update notification is tapped, Advanpro's update service targets this screen, which immediately closes without showing content. The SDK's normal update flow suppresses these notifications.
disableEffect: The normal update flow is unaffected; when DFU notifications are enabled, tapping one will no longer open this empty screen.
